'''Paal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal in the employ of [[Sylas Wilkes]] who was one of fifteen men tasked with guarding a shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and a [[Tulak Hord's artifact (Tatooine)|Sith artifact]] for their boss on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, the artifact drove the group mad, and they fled into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] with the blasters and the artifacts. As the artifact's influence over them grew, they were picked off one by one by either the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] or themselves. As only three men were left alive, Pall shot [[Bekis]] and decided to bring the artifact to a Sand People campsite as a peace offering, but was killed as soon as he got there.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Paal's corpse appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Tatooine.<ref name="SWTOR" />
